The customer has a prior confirmed fraud case (CC-4314) [EV-5a9e4abf], and the device fingerprint (Linux x86_64 Chrome 96.0 with synthetic identifiers) appears in another confirmed fraud case [EV-62d5ad6c]. Pattern retrieval identified six prior cases with the same card-not-present fraud pattern [EV-8c25b37f]. The customer affirms they did not authorize the purchases and retains physical possession of the card [EV-57783e08]. The investigation concluded with a fraud verdict and a fraud probability of 0.815.
